messages:
customer_engineer: Hey @support — since last night some of our requests are routing to us-west instead of eu-west. Latency jumped ~200ms for replies. Example request id: r-9f3a7e2. We pass region=eu as a query param. Any ideas?

sam_support: Thanks — can you paste the raw request headers or a curl repro? Also which account/org?

customer_engineer: Account acme-analytics. Quick repro we ran through our sidecar:
```bash
curl -v 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate?region=eu' \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-***' \n  -H 'x-client-region: ' \n  -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```
Proxy logs show the sidecar rewrites and appends x-client-region with an empty value when the upstream config has region unset.

ingrid_sre: Ah — router precedence picks header > query param. If header exists, even empty, earlier router logic treats that as explicit and routes to nearest POP. We have a known edge-case but not many customers hit it. Did you roll a proxy change recently?

customer_engineer: Yes — we rolled sidecar v2.4.0 last night that tries to normalize headers. Appears to append x-client-region: '' when the app doesn't set it.

matt_engineer: Assigning eng to look. Short-term workaround: strip the header in the proxy or set it explicitly to 'eu'. We'll also consider changing router to ignore zero-length strings.

customer_engineer: Workaround applied (removed x-client-region) and traffic returns to eu edges. Thanks. One more thing — any chance those misrouted calls were billed at higher egress rates? We show ~1.2k calls that went to us-west during the window.

sam_support: I'll tag billing now and open a cost-impact ticket — will include the request id sample. If delta looks material we'll request a credit.

ingrid_sre: Long-term we should treat empty/whitespace-only region headers as absent. I'll open an internal ticket to update router behavior and add a metric for 'region-header-empty'.

matt_engineer: I'll prepare a small patch: trim header value, if empty -> treat as missing. Add a counter metric and a debug log for first few occurrences per client. ETA 3-4 hours for canary if tests pass.

ops_oncall: FYI I'll coordinate canary rollout on the edge-router fleet and monitor for regressions (latency, 5xx).

route-bot: deploy started: edge-router-config v2026.03.17-7 (canary) — monitoring for 15m.

ingrid_sre: Quick check across last 24h: ~0.02% of requests had x-client-region present but empty. Looks like a handful of proxies doing this. Matt, include client-id and proto in logs for diagnosis.

matt_engineer: PR pushed with change + metric and additional logging: https://git.internal/redwood/edge-router/pull/487 (internal). Adding unit tests for header trimming.

route-bot: deploy success (canary) — edge-router-config v2026.03.17-7 canary green. Rolling to 10%.

customer_engineer: Great — we will also remove the header on our side tonight so we don't rely on router change. Sam: billing ticket number S-5729.

sam_support: Got it. I'll follow up on cost remediation and keep you posted. If you want a permanent enforcement rule we can add a router rule that rejects or normalizes empty header values for customers.

ingrid_sre: Action items: 1) router-ignore-empty-header rule rollout (full prod rollout scheduled after canary completes) 2) metric & alert for empty-region-header spikes 3) outreach doc for customers and proxysidecars. Closing loop when full rollout is done and billing outcome resolved.

customer_engineer: Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround — appreciate it.
